items.content:
The films that survive are the films someone decided to restore. That
decision is made by a small number of people with particular taste, and
then forty years later we call the result "the canon" as though it
precipitated out of the air.

Same mechanism as the acquisitions budget. Same mechanism as everything.

summary: Canon is curated taste, same gatekeeping as an acquisitions budget
title: A note on the Criterion problem
